title.en: Budget vs actuals: reading a variance

concept.hr: Odstupanje čine količina, cijena i vrijeme; račun koji kasni nije ušteda
concept.en: A variance is volume, price and timing; a late invoice is not a saving

summary.hr: Godina troškova oblaka i licenci prema mjesečnom planu: veća potrošnja, viša cijena i račun koji kasni, svaki dio odstupanja i prognoza za kraj godine.
summary.en: A year of cloud and licence costs against a monthly budget: more use, a price rise and a late invoice, each part of the variance and the year-end forecast.

title.en: Use it or lose it: an apparent saving

concept.hr: „Ispod plana” u listopadu bio je račun koji kasni; potrošen, završi iznad plana
concept.en: October's underspend was a late invoice; spending it ends the year over budget
